definite-integral.def: The limit of Riemann sums of a function $f$ on $[a, b]$ as the widths of the subintervals shrink to 0, written $\int_a^b f(x)\,dx$. The function $f(x)$ is the integrand; $a$ and $b$ are the limits of integration. For a positive $f$ it is the area under the graph; for a rate, the accumulated change.

sigma-notation.def: Shorthand for a sum: $\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_i$ means $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n$. A Riemann sum with right ends is $\sum_{i=1}^{n} f(x_i)\,\Delta x$, with $\Delta x = \frac{b - a}{n}$ and $x_i = a + i\,\Delta x$.
